title: G.C.E. O/L examination results released online
summary: The Department of Examinations has released the results of the General Certificate of Education (Ordinary Level) Examination online. Students can now access their results over the internet.

title: Fire destroys processed tea stock at Elpitiya tea factory
summary: A fire broke out at a tea factory located at Wathurawila Junction on the Elpitiya–Mapalagama Road this evening, causing extensive damage to the premises.

title: Italy cancels US visit after Trump says Meloni ‘Begged’ him for photo
summary: Italy’s foreign minister has canceled a planned visit to the United States over comments President Donald Trump made about Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni earlier this week.

title: ICC Chairman meets Dissanayake
summary: A meeting between President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and Mr Jay Shah, Chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC), was held this afternoon (19) at the Presidential Secretariat.

title: Israel, Hezbollah agree to ceasefire starting on Friday - US official
summary: Israel and Hezbollah have agreed to a ‌ceasefire set to begin at 4 p.m. local time on Friday, a senior ⁠U.S. official told Reuters.

title: Colombo Bank legal officer arrested for alleged theft
summary: A 47-year-old female lawyer attached to the legal division of a Colombo-based commercial bank was arrested last night (18) at a supermarket in Ratmalana while allegedly attempting to steal multiple items.

title: ICC chief Jay Shah to meet Sri Lanka President Dissanayake
summary: International Cricket Council (ICC) chairman Jay Shah will arrive here on Friday on a whistle-stop tour and meet Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, with the SLC interim committee issue expected to be high on the agenda, government sources said.

title: Over 40 arrested in Walana STF raid on massage centres
summary: A total of 43 individuals have been arrested following a series of raids carried out by the Walana Central Anti-Vice Strike Force on massage centres in the Thalawathugoda area.

title: Archchuna removes slipper-garlanded cut-out of himself
summary: Jaffna District MP Archchuna Ramanathan was seen removing a life-size cut-out of himself that had been decorated with a garland made of slippers and placed by the roadside in the Gurunagar area of Jaffna.

title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes kill 18 as Israel says four soldiers killed by Hezbollah
summary: At least 18 people have been killed in southern Lebanon following a series of Israeli air strikes overnight, the country’s health ministry has said - while the Israeli military says four of its soldiers were also killed.

title: ’The last ride’: Trump takes final flight on old Air Force One
summary: ’’I was honoured to be aboard Air Force One last night on its final flight,’’ Monica Crowley, the US chief of protocol, said on X.

title: US-Iran talks postponed as Vance pulls out of Switzerland trip
summary: A new round of direct talks between the US and Iran have been postponed after Vice-President JD Vance delayed a planned trip to Switzerland.

title: Sri Lanka’s Liberal Youth Movement joins global liberal youth federation
summary: The Liberal Youth Movement (LYM) of Sri Lanka has secured official membership in the International Federation of Liberal Youth (IFLRY), marking a significant milestone for youth-led civic engagement in the country.
